requirements_summary: Workload: chat-first (support agent) + doc search for knowledge base
Latency target: p95 < 300ms for short responses; sub-second for most queries
Throughput: bursty during day; ~20 concurrent chat sessions expected initially
Cost sensitivity: high — looking to optimize token cost and prefer cheap fallbacks
Quality target: keep customer-facing answers accurate, occasional longer/high-quality responses acceptable
Model preferences: open to Llama/Mistral/Qwen families; wants guidance on specific variants (7B vs 13B/14B vs quantized options)
Routing/fallback need: automatic fallback to cheaper model on throttling or cost guardrails
Security: SSO later, SOC2 baseline, audit logs required for compliance review
quotes: We want the smallest model that doesn't sound 'wrong' — cheaper is ok until it starts hallucinating.
